purpose: Teach: 櫃/鷯/豺/厘/平蔵/少佐/空海/膣

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古い医療用櫃、つまり薬箱の保管を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be researching the storage and preservation of historical medical chests with the medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional tone. Measured pace. Direct eye contact. Steady delivery with slight emphasis on 'researching' — informative without being clinical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鳥インフル研究で鷯、つまり鷯属の感染リスクを医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be monitoring avian influenza infection risk in wren species with the medical team.
lines.style: Same measured professionalism. Slight pause before the technical term to signal its importance. Calm, confident — she knows this material.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、豺、つまり野犬咬傷の症例を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be coordinating case management for wild dog bite injuries with the medical team.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. No dramatization of the serious subject matter. Businesslike but not cold — this is routine protocol for her.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医薬品の単価が一厘単位、つまり厘までの精度を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be managing pharmaceutical cost tracking down to the smallest unit of precision with the medical team.
lines.style: Precise enunciation on the technical specification. Slightly slower pace to ensure understanding. Detail-oriented without being pedantic.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者平蔵様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue close monitoring of patient Heizou's condition with the medical team.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Name pronounced with slight respect. Slower pace here — this is about ongoing care, not one-time research.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧軍少佐の戦傷ケアの歴史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be studying the history of war wound care for former military officers with the medical team.
lines.style: Respectful, quieter tone. Weight given to 'history' — acknowledging the gravity of what came before. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、空海ゆかりの薬草の医療史を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be researching the medical history of medicinal herbs associated with Kobo Daishi with the medical team.
lines.style: Engaged but measured. Slight warmth on the cultural reference — this bridges history and healing. Still professional, but less purely clinical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、膣、つまり膣分泌物の検査を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be conducting careful testing of vaginal secretions with the medical team.
lines.style: Professional, unhurried. Matter-of-fact clinical language, delivered with the same steady care as any other procedure. No awkwardness — this is medical work.
